menu_options.hub: Home: reference devices and people per room

device.title: Set up MaNoUmi
device.description: Room detection for a Bluetooth device. Requires the device to be set up via Private BLE Device (iPhone/Apple Watch via IRK).

data_description.areas: Rooms with Bluetooth scanners are preselected. Rooms without a scanner can be added – every room is detected once it has been calibrated.
data_description.notify_service: Start and end of a calibration always create a Home Assistant notification. With a notify service (e.g. notify.mobile_app_…) also as a push to your phone.

hub.title: MaNoUmi home
hub.description: Once per installation. Counts how many tracked devices are in each room and uses stationary BLE devices as reference: if the scanners suddenly hear them weaker or stronger, this is removed from all measurements – the calibration stays valid.

data_description.anchors: Stationary Bluetooth devices (e.g. thermometers). Do not move them; after moving one, press “Re-capture baseline”.

error.anchor_no_ble: At least one device has no Bluetooth address.
error.anchor_is_scanner: Scanners cannot be reference devices at the same time.

abort.already_configured: This tracker is already set up.
abort.already_hub: The home is already set up.

data_description.anchors: Stationary Bluetooth devices (e.g. thermometers). Do not move them; after moving one, press “Re-capture baseline”.
data_description.capture: Writes all measurement windows (reference and tracked devices) to /config/manoumi/capture.jsonl – for analysis. Max 20 MB, then rotated.

calibrate.name: Calibrate room
calibrate.description: Learns the signal pattern of a room. Stay in the room and move normally for the duration.

room.name: Room
room.description: Name or area ID of the room.

mode.name: Mode
mode.description: New replaces the room, Add adds a position. Defaults to the calibration mode select.
